These models do not count towards the Army's Break Point.

keywords.name: Hatred (Uruk-hai)
keywords.definition: As Hatred (X), with Uruk-hai as the listed keyword.

keywords.name: Arcing Shot
keywords.definition:
A Siege Engine that Shoots by Arcing Shot does not need Line of Sight to its target, or to a model its shot would scatter on to, so long as another friendly model has Line of Sight to the initial target. After determining the actual target, a Siege Engine with Arcing Shot does not make In The Way Tests for intervening models and terrain (the shot goes over them). However, anything that is clearly taller than the actual target and would be above the actual target when the shot comes down will incur an In The Way Test. This could include the likes of trees, ledges, or rocks that jut out from cliff faces; a degree of common sense will be needed here - a whole tree would provide this In The Way, but a single branch would not!
                This is also the case for when a Siege Engine with Arcing Shot hits a War Beast with a Howdah, as the Howdah is above the War Beast and so will provide an In The Way Test

keywords.name: Static
keywords.definition: If a Siege Engine has the Static special rule, then it cannot be Moved or rotated.

keywords.name: Area Effect
keywords.definition: After rolling To Hit against hte actual target, if the actual target was a Battlefield Target then all other models within 2" of the actual target suffer a Strength 5 hit and, if they survive, will be knocked Prone.

keywords.name: Wall-breaker
keywords.definition: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, this model makes 2 To-Wound Rolls and picks the highest. Additionally, a successful To Wound Roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.

keywords.name: Haradrim Training
keywords.definition: This model gains +2 to its Courage Test when attempting to Charge a model with the Terror special rule.

keywords.name: Guardians of the Ithil Stone
keywords.definition: This model gains the Bodyguard special rule for any friendly Gondor Hero that is in possession of the Ithil Stone. Additionally, while this model is within 3" of the Ithil Stone, it increases its Attacks to 2.

keywords.name: The Ithil Stone
keywords.definition: The Ithil Stone begins carried by the Army's General. If the model carrying the Ithil Stone is a friendly Gondor, non-Spirit Hero model it may use the Ithil Stone while carrying the object. At the end of the game, if a friendly model is carrying this object then this side gains an additional 2 Victory Points; if an enemy model is carrying this object then your opponent gains 1 Victory Point. In either instance this can never take an Army's total above 20.

keywords.name: Weather the siege
keywords.definition: Friendly Warrior models in this Army treat Unique Gondor Hero models as banners with a range of 3". If this Army is Broken, this range is increased to 6" and friendly Gondor Warrior models also gain +1 Fight.

keywords.name: Hatred (Orc, Uruk-hai)
keywords.definition: As Hatred (X), with Orc and Uruk-hai as the listed keywords.

keywords.name: Leader (Ithil Stone Guard)
keywords.definition: As Leader (X), with Ithil Stone Guard as the listed model.

keywords.name: Bodyguard (Castamir)
keywords.definition: As Bodyguard, with Castamir as the named model.

keywords.name: Poisoned Attacks (throwing weapon)
keywords.definition: Poisoned Attacks applies to this model's throwing weapon.

keywords.name: "I am one, but we are many"
keywords.definition: Before deployment, you may nominate a single Orc, Uruk-hai or Olog-hai Infantry Hero model in Talion's Army to be kept in reserve instead of deploying normally. If the chosen Hero is a Leader for a Warband, choose one other model in that Warband to act as its Leader. At the start of Talion's Activation during the Move Phase, Talion may summon the reserved Hero. Place that Hero wholly within 3" of Talion and within the Control Zone of an enemy model. The summoned Hero must Activate next.

keywords.name: Shattered Dominance
keywords.definition: If Talion is required to make a Wraith Resurrection roll, then during the following turn, at the start of each other friendly Hero model's Activation in the Move Phase, that Hero must take a Courage Test as though the force were Broken. If there are no other friendly Hero models remaining on the battlefield, then all remaining friendly Warrior models must instead take Courage Tests as though the force were Broken. This special rule does not affect Ratbag.

keywords.name: Aura of Dread
keywords.definition: Enemy models that are part of a Fight involving The Black Hand of Sauron can only re-roll a die in the Duel Roll if the initial die rolled is a natural 1.

keywords.name: A Sacrifice of Blood
keywords.definition: Keep track of how many Wounds The Black Hand causes in Combat. Once he has caused two or more Wounds, he may spend Will Points as if they were Fate Points. Once he has caused five or more Wounds, he gains Mighty Blow. Once he has caused eight or more Wounds, he gains Fearless and his Stand Fast is increased to 12".

keywords.name: Dark Ritual
keywords.definition: At the start of the Fight Phase, The Black Hand may choose to take a Wound, which he may try to save if possible. If he does, he gains +1 Fight Value, Strength and Attacks until the end of the turn. At the end of the Fight Phase, if he killed at least one enemy model in that Phase, he restores a single Will Point lost earlier in the battle. If the Wound caused by this rule would remove his last Wound, he may instead call a free Heroic Combat and gains +2 Fight Value, Strength and Attacks; he is then removed as a casualty at the end of the turn.

keywords.name: Relentless Charge
keywords.definition: In a turn in which The Hammer of Sauron has Charged, he increases his Attacks to 3 until the end of the turn.

keywords.name: "Bring me that head!"
keywords.definition: At the beginning of The Hammer of Sauron's Activation in the Move Phase, choose one enemy Hero within 6". If that model is removed as a casualty in the Fight Phase, all friendly models that were in that Fight will Move exactly as if they had won a Heroic Combat.

keywords.name: "The Warchiefs did NOTHING to prevent this sacrilege?!"
keywords.definition: At the start of his Activation, The Hammer of Sauron may kill a friendly Orc Infantry model within 2"; remove that model as a casualty. All friendly models within 6" of The Hammer gain Fearless until the end of the turn. If the model killed is a Hero, all friendly models also gain +1 To Wound when making Strikes until the end of the turn.

keywords.name: "I can see through your tricks"
keywords.definition: If an enemy model with the Stalk Unseen or Invisible special rule is within 12" of The Tower of Sauron, all friendly models within 6" of The Tower gain Fell Sight.

keywords.name: Illusion of strength
keywords.definition: At the start of any Fight Phase, The Tower of Sauron may take an Intelligence Test. If passed, choose one friendly model within 6". That model may choose to increase its Fight Value, Strength or Attacks to the same as The Tower of Sauron's until the end of the turn.

keywords.name: Marked by The Hand
keywords.definition: While The Black Hand of Sauron is alive and on the battlefield, Uruk-hai Warchief models in this Army gain Fearless.

keywords.name: The Talons of the Hand
keywords.definition: Up to five Uruk-hai Warchief models, chosen before deployment, gain the following: while this model is alive and on the battlefield, your opponent cannot score any Victory Points for Wounding or slaying your General.

keywords.name: Harbinger of Evil (6")
keywords.definition: As Harbinger of Evil (X), with a range of 6".

keywords.name: Immovable Object
keywords.definition: Graug models can never be Knocked Prone for any reason, cannot be Hurled or Barged. Additionally, a Graug will never Back Away if it loses a Combat; its opponents must Back Away instead. The only exception is if a Graug is fighting a model with a similar special rule that has a higher Strength, in which case the Graug Backs Away as normal. A Graug only counts as Trapped if the combined Strength of all enemy models in base contact is greater than the Graug's Strength.

keywords.name: Relentless Advance
keywords.definition: This model may Move through friendly non-Monster models when it Charges an enemy model, though not when forced to Move by an enemy Magical Power. Each friendly model Moved through suffers a Strength 5 hit. This model may finish its Move overlapping friendly non-Monster models; any friendly models it finishes overlapping are automatically slain.

keywords.name: Sovereign Predator
keywords.definition: The White Graug may allocate any number of its Strikes towards friendly Ghûl models in base contact with itself or in the same Fight. If the White Graug kills a model in this way, it regains one Wound lost earlier in the battle.

keywords.name: Ashen Body
keywords.definition: This model's Attacks are fire-based. Additionally, this model is immune to fire-based attacks.

keywords.name: Flame Breath
keywords.definition: This is a fire-based Shooting Attack treated as a bow with a range of 6". The target suffers a Strength 6 hit; then roll a D6 for the target and each model in base contact with it. On a natural 6, that model is Set Ablaze.

keywords.name: Festering Bulk
keywords.definition: This model gains Poisoned Attacks. Additionally, this model is immune to the effects of Poisoned Attacks and Venom.

keywords.name: Toxic spit
keywords.definition: This is a Shooting Attack treated as a bow with a range of 6". If it hits the target, all models in base contact with the target are also hit. Each model hit suffers a Strength 3 hit. This Shooting Attack has the Venom special rule.

keywords.name: Frozen Juggernaut
keywords.definition: This model gains +1 Defence and +1 Wound. Additionally, this model gains Resistant to Magic.

keywords.name: Icy Torrent
keywords.definition: This is a Shooting Attack treated as a bow with a range of 6". If it hits the target, all models in base contact with the target are also hit. Each model hit suffers a Strength 4 hit. Any model hit reduces its Attacks to 1 until the end of the turn.

keywords.name: Many bodies
keywords.definition: This model may only be Wounded by Shooting Attacks on a natural 6.

keywords.name: Aerial hunter
keywords.definition: This model gains +1 To Wound when making Strikes against models with the Fly special rule.

keywords.name: Venomous bite
keywords.definition: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound and the target model survives, the target model reduces its Strength by 1.

keywords.name: Monsterbane
keywords.definition: Monsterbane as used by the supplied Caragor profiles.

keywords.name: The Most Dominant Species
keywords.definition: If The White Graug is your General, it gains Harbinger of Evil (12"). Additionally, it counts as a banner with a range of 6" and counts as a banner for the purposes of Victory Points.

keywords.name: Call of the Hive
keywords.definition: If this Army does not contain The White Graug, choose one Ghûl Matron to be the Army General. It gains Harbinger of Evil (6") and General Hunter. Additionally, all Ghûl models within 6" gain Fearless.

keywords.name: Beasts of the Lairs
keywords.definition: A Warband in this Army that contains at least one Dire Caragor and at least four additional Caragor models does not need a Hero to be its Leader. Instead, choose one Dire Caragor to be the Warband Leader for deployment. Additionally, Caragor models in this Army within 3" of a Dire Caragor that has passed its Intelligence Test for Unruly Strength may choose whether or not to pass their Intelligence Test.

keywords.name: Dominant (6)
keywords.definition: As Dominant (X), with a value of 6.

keywords.name: Tribe Fortress
keywords.definition: After both sides deploy, place three 25mm Influence Markers. They cannot be placed within an enemy deployment zone, within 6" of an Objective Marker, within 18" of another Influence Marker, within 8" of the centre, within Impassable Terrain, or within an enemy Control Zone. Each marker has Defence 8 and 2 Wounds and may be attacked as a Siege Engine. A marker is Active while a friendly Warchief with the same Tribe keyword as the Dominant Tribe is within 3". Before Priority, if the Dominant Tribe's Overlord is within 3" of an Active marker, it may invoke that Tribe's Fortress Ability.

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Warrior Training
keywords.definition: Dark Tribe Orc Warrior and Dark Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models reduce the cost of their Dual Blades option to 1 point. Dark Tribe Olog-hai models gain Resistant to Poison.

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Dark Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above gain Poisoned Attacks and Resistant to Poison.

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Dark Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above gain Venom.

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: Friendly Dark Tribe Warrior models within 3" of the Dark Tribe Overlord count as having Poisoned Attacks.

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Dark Tribe models count as having Stalk Unseen.

keywords.name: Shadow Network
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, whenever an enemy model Charges a friendly Dark Tribe model within 6" of an Active Influence Marker, the charging model immediately suffers one Strength 2 hit with Poisoned Attacks.

keywords.name: Feral Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Feral Tribe Uruk-hai Caragor Riders and Feral Tribe Orc Caragor Riders add Chained Bolas to their options for 2 points. Feral Tribe Orc Hero and Uruk-hai Hero models add Chained Bolas for 5 points.

keywords.name: Feral Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Feral Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above may include Caragor models as Followers in their Warband, even if those models are not listed in the same Army List.

keywords.name: Feral Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Friendly Caragor models within 6" of a Feral Tribe Hero model of this Heroic Tier or above may re-roll failed Intelligence Tests.

keywords.name: Feral Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: The Feral Tribe Overlord may include a single Graug model as a Follower in its Warband, even if that model is not listed in the same Army List.

keywords.name: Feral Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Feral Tribe Mount and Beast models increase their Move Value by 2".

keywords.name: Beast Cages
keywords.definition: Immediately place a Caragor beside each Active Influence Marker. These Caragors are Reinforcements, may not Charge that turn, and do not count towards the Army's Break Point.

keywords.name: Machine Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Machine Tribe Orc Warrior and Machine Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models add Machine Hook to their options for 2 points. Machine Tribe Orc Hero and Uruk-hai Hero models add Twin Hand-crossbows to their options for 5 points.

keywords.name: Machine Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Shooting Attacks made by Machine Tribe Orc and Uruk-hai Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above gain Grappling Shot.

keywords.name: Machine Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Machine Tribe Olog-hai Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above add Olog-hai Flamethrower to their options for 40 points.

keywords.name: Machine Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: Friendly Machine Tribe models within 6" of the Machine Tribe Overlord may re-roll a single failed To Wound Roll when making a Shooting Attack with a Throwing Weapon.

keywords.name: Machine Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Friendly Machine Tribe models within 3" of an Active Influence Marker add 2" to the Range of their Shooting Attacks.

keywords.name: Ammunition Stores
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, increase the Strength characteristic of all Shooting Attacks made by friendly Machine Tribe models by 1.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Marauder Tribe Infantry models gain Scavenge. Marauder Tribe Olog-hai models gain Burly while in a Fight that includes two or more enemy models.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Marauder Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above gain +1 Fight Value if equipped with a piece of Scavenged Wargear.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Marauder Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above gain Burly.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: The Marauder Tribe Overlord gains +1 Fight Value and +1 Strength when fighting a model with a higher Fight Value or Strength than its own.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Marauder Tribe models gain Dominant (2) if equipped with a piece of Scavenged Wargear.

keywords.name: Spoils of War
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, friendly Marauder Tribe models with one or more pieces of Scavenged Wargear gain +1 Attack.

keywords.name: Mystic Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Mystic Tribe Orc Warrior and Mystic Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models reduce the cost of their Dual Blades option to 1 point. Mystic Tribe Olog-hai models gain Resistant to Magic.

keywords.name: Mystic Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Mystic Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above gain Fury (X), where X is the Race of the caster. It targets the caster and is cast on a 5+.

keywords.name: Mystic Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Mystic Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above add Morgul Blade to their options for 5 points and gain Instil Fear, targeting the caster and cast on a 5+.

keywords.name: Mystic Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: Friendly Mystic Tribe Warrior models within 3" of the Mystic Tribe Overlord count as having Blades of the Dead.

keywords.name: Mystic Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Mystic Tribe models count as having Resistant to Magic.

keywords.name: Mystic Ritual
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly Mystic Tribe model makes a Casting Roll or Resist Test, it may change the result of one die to a 5.

keywords.name: Outlaw Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Outlaw Tribe Orc Warrior and Outlaw Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models add Chained Bolas to their options for 2 points. Outlaw Tribe Olog-hai models increase their Courage and Intelligence by 1.

keywords.name: Outlaw Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Outlaw Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above always win a Drawn Combat if the enemy model is Prone.

keywords.name: Outlaw Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Outlaw Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier or above never worsen their Shoot Value when Moving and Shooting with a Throwing Weapon.

keywords.name: Outlaw Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: The Stand Fast of the Outlaw Tribe Overlord affects all friendly Outlaw Tribe models within range.

keywords.name: Outlaw Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Outlaw Tribe models may re-roll a single die in the Duel Roll when in a Fight with a Prone model.

keywords.name: Hidden Snares
keywords.definition: At the end of the Move Phase, roll a D6 for any enemy model on a 25mm base that is Engaged in Combat with a friendly Outlaw Tribe model. On a 4+, that model is Knocked Prone.

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Slaughter Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models add Slaughter Cleavers to their options for 2 points. The source also states: 'Outlaw Tribe Olog-hai models may re-roll a single failed To Wound Roll when using the Rend Brutal Power Attack.'

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Slaughter Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above increase their Attacks by 1 when Engaged in Combat with two or more enemy models.

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Slaughter Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier gain General Hunter.

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: All friendly Slaughter Tribe models within 3" of the Slaughter Tribe Overlord count their Fight Value 1 higher when Engaged in Combat against an enemy model that has lost one or more Wounds.

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Slaughter Tribe models may re-roll a single failed To Wound Roll when in a Fight with a model that has lost one or more Wounds.

keywords.name: Feast on Carnage
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, if a friendly Slaughter Tribe model slays an enemy model in Combat, it may immediately make one additional Strike against another enemy model involved in the same Combat.

keywords.name: Terror Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Terror Tribe Orc Warrior and Terror Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models add Throwing Weapons to their options for 2 points. Terror Tribe Olog-hai models gain Harbinger of Evil (3").

keywords.name: Terror Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Terror Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above that declare a Charge against an enemy model with Terror may re-roll a failed Courage Test to see whether they can Charge.

keywords.name: Terror Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Terror Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above gain Harbinger of Evil (3"). Terror Tribe Olog-hai Heroes of this Heroic Tier and above increase this to 6".

keywords.name: Terror Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: The source states: 'Enemy Warrior models within 6" of the Slaughter Tribe Overlord cannot benefit from a friendly Hero model's Stand Fast.' This rule appears under the Terror Tribe Overlord heading.

keywords.name: Terror Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Terror Tribe Hero models and friendly Terror Tribe Warrior models within 3" of a Terror Tribe Hero gain Terror.

keywords.name: Fearsome Visage
keywords.definition: At the beginning of the Move Phase, all enemy Hero models must pass a Courage Test. If failed, that model cannot Move that turn, but may otherwise act normally.

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Warmonger Tribe Orc Warrior and Warmonger Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models add War Drum to their options for 30 points. Warmonger Tribe Olog-hai models with an Olog-hai mace may use Shielding.

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Captain
keywords.definition: Warmonger Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above may exchange their armour for heavy armour for free.

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Warchief
keywords.definition: Warmonger Tribe Hero models of this Heroic Tier and above, and any Followers in their Warband, gain Shieldwall.

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Overlord
keywords.definition: Warmonger Tribe models count the Warmonger Tribe Overlord as a Banner with a range of 6".

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Influence
keywords.definition: Whilst at least one Influence Marker is Active, friendly Warmonger Tribe models that elect to Shield may still be Supported.

keywords.name: Martialed Advance
keywords.definition: Until the end of the turn, friendly Warmonger Tribe models may Charge even if they are within range of a friendly War Drum. Additionally, friendly War Drums carried by Warmonger Tribe models count as banners with a range of 6".

keywords.name: Resistant to Poison
keywords.definition: If this model would suffer a Wound from a Strike with the Poisoned Attacks or Venom special rules, roll a D6. On a 6, the Wound is ignored.

keywords.name: Poisoned Attacks
keywords.definition: This model has Poisoned Attacks.

keywords.name: Grappling Shot
keywords.definition: An Infantry model on a 25mm base that is hit by a Shooting Attack from a weapon with this special rule, and is not removed as a casualty, is pulled in a straight line 3" towards this model. It stops if it comes into base contact with any other model or obstacle.

keywords.name: Fury (X)
keywords.definition: Fury (X), where X is the Race of the caster.

keywords.name: Harbinger of Evil (3")
keywords.definition: As Harbinger of Evil (X), with a range of 3".

keywords.name: Dark Tribe Training
keywords.definition: Dark Tribe Orc Warrior and Dark Tribe Uruk-hai Warrior models reduce the cost of their Dual Blades option to 1 point. Dark Tribe Olog-hai models gain Resistant to Poison.

keywords.name: Dominant Tribe
keywords.definition: When building the Army, choose one Tribe as the Dominant Tribe. The first non-Unique Hero selected must belong to that Tribe. Any Followers in the Warband of a Unique Hero must also belong to the Dominant Tribe. The Dominant Tribe must contain more models than all other Tribes in the Army combined.

keywords.name: Marauder Tribe Olog-hai
keywords.definition: This model gains the Burly special rule while it is involved in a Fight that includes two or more enemy models.

keywords.name: Warmonger Tribe Olog-hai
keywords.definition: If this model is equipped with an Olog-hai mace, it may use the Shielding special rule.

keywords.name: Slaughter Tribe Olog-hai
keywords.definition: This model may re-roll a single failed To Wound Roll when using the Rend Brutal Power Attack. The supplied Slaughter Tribe page labels this as applying to an 'Outlaw Tribe Olog-hai'; this entry applies the rule to the Slaughter Tribe Olog-hai as the contextual reading of that section.

armyBonuses.name: Call of the Hive
armyBonuses.definition: If this Army does not contain The White Graug, choose one Ghûl Matron to be the Army General. It gains Harbinger of Evil (6") and General Hunter. Additionally, all Ghûl models within 6" gain Fearless.

armyBonuses.name: For Hope of Family
armyBonuses.definition: Talion's Family may either start the game deployed as a single warband or as Followers in another friendly Hero model's warband, other than Talion's. If chosen as their own warband then up to six models from Talion's warband may instead deploy with Talion's Family, in which case Ioreth will count as the Warband Leader. Talion's Family must be deployed at least 18" away from Talion. Ioreth automatically counts as rolling a 4+ for her Healer's Touch special rule when targeting Talion. While within 3" of Dirhael, Talion gains the Mighty Hero special rule. At the End of the Game, score an additional Victory Point for each of Ioreth and Dirhael that is still alive, or has escaped the battlefield in Scenarios where this applies. This can never take the Army above 20 Victory Points.

armyBonuses.name: Stalwart Defenders
armyBonuses.definition: Shooting Attacks that require an In The Way test for targeting friendly Gondor models in base contact with an Obstacle will only hit on a 5+.

armyBonuses.name: An Army of Rangers
armyBonuses.definition: A Black Gate Garrison Army ignores the normal restrictions for Bow Limit.

armyBonuses.name: Free the Prisoners
armyBonuses.definition: At the start of the game, before either side deploys, your opponent places three 25mm Prisoner Markers on the battlefield. Each Marker must be placed within 8" of the centre of the board and not within 6" of another Prisoner Marker. At the end of any turn, if a friendly Man model is in base contact with a Prisoner Marker, remove that Marker from play. Once one Marker has been removed, friendly Man models gain +1 Courage. Once a second Marker has been removed, friendly Man Hero models count as banners with a range of 3". Once all Markers are removed, your Army's General model's Stand Fast affects friendly Hero models.

armyBonuses.name: Convient Alliance
armyBonuses.definition: Only friendly Orc and Uruk-hai models can benefit from Heroic Actions and Stand Fast of friendly Uruk-hai Hero models. Additionally, Ratbag may only be included in your Army if Talion is also part of the Army. In a fight that contains at least one friendly Orc or Uruk-hai model and at least one friendly Man model, if that Combat is lost, then immediately, before all other Strikes, the Man model suffers a single Strength 3 hit.

armyBonuses.name: Salt in the Blood
armyBonuses.definition: At the start of the Move Phase, nominate one friendly Nûrn Hero model. Until the end of the turn, that model and all friendly Nûrn Warrior models within 3" gain the current-turn effect: Turn 1 — Approaching Tide: +3" Move during the Move Phase; this cannot be increased by Heroic March. Turn 2 — Cast the Nets: models with Entangling Throw may also affect Infantry models with Strength 5 or less. Turn 3 — Pull Together: models may use throwing spears as a normal spear during the Fight Phase if they have not made a Shooting Attack with it in the preceding Move or Shoot Phase. Turn 4 — Close the Traps: +1 to Duel Rolls when fighting an enemy that is Trapped. Turn 5 onwards — Break the Tide: models gain Dominant (2).

armyBonuses.name: Break the Chains
armyBonuses.definition: At the start of the game, after both sides have deployed, place 3 Captive Markers on the battlefield. In Scenarios using standard deployment zones, each must be wholly within 12" of the enemy board edge and more than 6" from any board-edge corner. In Maelstrom of Battle deployment, they must instead be wholly within 12" of the centre. Each Captive Marker must be more than 6" from any other Captive Marker. If a friendly Nûrn Infantry model is in base contact with a Captive Marker at the end of the turn, roll a D6; on a 4+, immediately place D3 Liberated Captive models within 3" of the marker and not within 1" of enemy models, then remove the Marker. These models do not count towards the Army's Break Point.

armyBonuses.name: The Ithil Stone
armyBonuses.definition: The Ithil Stone begins carried by the Army's General. If the model carrying the Ithil Stone is a friendly Gondor, non-Spirit Hero model it may use the Ithil Stone while carrying the object. At the end of the game, if a friendly model is carrying this object then this side gains an additional 2 Victory Points; if an enemy model is carrying this object then your opponent gains 1 Victory Point. In either instance this can never take an Army's total above 20.

armyBonuses.name: Weather the siege
armyBonuses.definition: Friendly Warrior models in this Army treat Unique Gondor Hero models as banners with a range of 3". If this Army is Broken, this range is increased to 6" and friendly Gondor Warrior models also gain +1 Fight.

armyBonuses.name: "I am one, but we are many"
armyBonuses.definition: Before deployment, you may nominate a single Orc, Uruk-hai or Olog-hai Infantry Hero model in Talion's Army to be kept in reserve instead of deploying normally. If the chosen Hero is a Leader for a Warband, choose one other model in that Warband to act as its Leader. At the start of Talion's Activation during the Move Phase, Talion may summon the reserved Hero. Place that Hero wholly within 3" of Talion and within the Control Zone of an enemy model. The summoned Hero must Activate next.

armyBonuses.name: Shattered Dominance
armyBonuses.definition: If Talion is required to make a Wraith Resurrection roll, then during the following turn, at the start of each other friendly Hero model's Activation in the Move Phase, that Hero must take a Courage Test as though the force were Broken. If there are no other friendly Hero models remaining on the battlefield, then all remaining friendly Warrior models must instead take Courage Tests as though the force were Broken. This special rule does not affect Ratbag.

armyBonuses.name: "Bring me that head!"
armyBonuses.definition: At the beginning of The Hammer of Sauron's Activation in the Move Phase, choose one enemy Hero within 6". If that model is removed as a casualty in the Fight Phase, all friendly models that were in that Fight will Move exactly as if they had won a Heroic Combat.

armyBonuses.name: "The Warchiefs did NOTHING to prevent this sacrilege?!"
armyBonuses.definition: At the start of his Activation, The Hammer of Sauron may kill a friendly Orc Infantry model within 2"; remove that model as a casualty. All friendly models within 6" of The Hammer gain Fearless until the end of the turn. If the model killed is a Hero, all friendly models also gain +1 To Wound when making Strikes until the end of the turn.

armyBonuses.name: "I can see through your tricks"
armyBonuses.definition: If an enemy model with the Stalk Unseen or Invisible special rule is within 12" of The Tower of Sauron, all friendly models within 6" of The Tower gain Fell Sight.

armyBonuses.name: Illusion of strength
armyBonuses.definition: At the start of any Fight Phase, The Tower of Sauron may take an Intelligence Test. If passed, choose one friendly model within 6". That model may choose to increase its Fight Value, Strength or Attacks to the same as The Tower of Sauron's until the end of the turn.

armyBonuses.name: Marked by The Hand
armyBonuses.definition: While The Black Hand of Sauron is alive and on the battlefield, Uruk-hai Warchief models in this Army gain Fearless.

armyBonuses.name: The Talons of the Hand
armyBonuses.definition: Up to five Uruk-hai Warchief models, chosen before deployment, gain the following: while this model is alive and on the battlefield, your opponent cannot score any Victory Points for Wounding or slaying your General.

armyBonuses.name: The Most Dominant Species
armyBonuses.definition: If The White Graug is your General, it gains Harbinger of Evil (12"). Additionally, it counts as a banner with a range of 6" and counts as a banner for the purposes of Victory Points.

armyBonuses.name: Beasts of the Lairs
armyBonuses.definition: A Warband in this Army that contains at least one Dire Caragor and at least four additional Caragor models does not need a Hero to be its Leader. Instead, choose one Dire Caragor to be the Warband Leader for deployment. Additionally, Caragor models in this Army within 3" of a Dire Caragor that has passed its Intelligence Test for Unruly Strength may choose whether or not to pass their Intelligence Test.

armyBonuses.name: Tribes of the Orcs
armyBonuses.definition: When choosing a Hero model's Tribe, add the chosen Tribe to that model's Faction keyword. All Warrior models in that Hero's Warband gain the same Tribe keyword and benefit from that Tribe's bonuses. Hero bonuses are cumulative by tier: a Warchief also gains its Tribe's Captain rule, and an Overlord gains the Captain, Warchief and Overlord rules.

armyBonuses.name: Tribe Fortress
armyBonuses.definition: After both sides deploy, place three 25mm Influence Markers. They cannot be placed within an enemy deployment zone, within 6" of an Objective Marker, within 18" of another Influence Marker, within 8" of the centre, within Impassable Terrain, or within an enemy Control Zone. Each marker has Defence 8 and 2 Wounds and may be attacked as a Siege Engine. A marker is Active while a friendly Warchief with the same Tribe keyword as the Dominant Tribe is within 3". Before Priority, if the Dominant Tribe's Overlord is within 3" of an Active marker, it may invoke that Tribe's Fortress Ability.

armyBonuses.name: Shadow Network
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, whenever an enemy model Charges a friendly Dark Tribe model within 6" of an Active Influence Marker, the charging model immediately suffers one Strength 2 hit with Poisoned Attacks.

armyBonuses.name: Beast Cages
armyBonuses.definition: Immediately place a Caragor beside each Active Influence Marker. These Caragors are Reinforcements, may not Charge that turn, and do not count towards the Army's Break Point.

armyBonuses.name: Ammunition Stores
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, increase the Strength characteristic of all Shooting Attacks made by friendly Machine Tribe models by 1.

armyBonuses.name: Spoils of War
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, friendly Marauder Tribe models with one or more pieces of Scavenged Wargear gain +1 Attack.

armyBonuses.name: Mystic Ritual
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly Mystic Tribe model makes a Casting Roll or Resist Test, it may change the result of one die to a 5.

armyBonuses.name: Hidden Snares
armyBonuses.definition: At the end of the Move Phase, roll a D6 for any enemy model on a 25mm base that is Engaged in Combat with a friendly Outlaw Tribe model. On a 4+, that model is Knocked Prone.

armyBonuses.name: Feast on Carnage
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, if a friendly Slaughter Tribe model slays an enemy model in Combat, it may immediately make one additional Strike against another enemy model involved in the same Combat.

armyBonuses.name: Fearsome Visage
armyBonuses.definition: At the beginning of the Move Phase, all enemy Hero models must pass a Courage Test. If failed, that model cannot Move that turn, but may otherwise act normally.

armyBonuses.name: Martialed Advance
armyBonuses.definition: Until the end of the turn, friendly Warmonger Tribe models may Charge even if they are within range of a friendly War Drum. Additionally, friendly War Drums carried by Warmonger Tribe models count as banners with a range of 6".
